name: AI Adaptation Leadership Deck
tagline: The heads’ view: what to adopt, what to host, what to defer.

page.objective: Give studio leadership a decision-ready view of AI adoption rather than a technology tour.
page.problem: Leadership needed to make hosting and spend decisions without a technical briefing.
page.solution: A deck framed around decisions, with the open-source-on-our-own-hardware position argued explicitly.
